scripts.build: bun run --filter @nest-my-admin/ui build && bun run --filter @nest-my-admin/core build && bun run --filter @nest-my-admin/auth build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @nest-my-admin/core build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages examples
scripts.e2e: bun run build && bun run --filter demo-api e2e
scripts.e2e:screens: bun run build && bun run --filter demo-api e2e:screens
